message:
I want to create a robust, highly customizable, and adaptive full-stack Python project planner application that leverages the astral-sh/uv tool for project environment management and packaging. The application should provide a modern user experience with the latest Material UI standards and include secure multi-user access with sharing functionality. This planner must be flexible enough to suit various user needs and scalable for future feature expansions.

Core Features and Requirements:
Multi-Project Management

Track multiple projects simultaneously.

Each project has start dates and deadlines.

Projects include descriptive metadata fields fully customizable by the user (e.g., description, owner, promoter, custom fields).

Hierarchical Tasks and Subtasks

Support arbitrary-depth task and subtask hierarchies inside projects.

Every level (project, task, subtask) can assign an owner and a promoter.

Allow owners to specify their email address linked to their tasks.

User Authentication & Authorization

Implement login system for users to securely access their projects.

Support collaboration by allowing project owners to share projects with other registered users, with permission controls.

Interactive Visualizations

Present Gantt charts visualizing tasks and subtasks progress against their timelines.

Show progress bars for each project level that dynamically update based on underlying task statuses, with status propagation upward through the hierarchy.

Provide a calendar chart (calendar heatmap or timeline view) that displays all projects’ starting and deadline dates across a timeline to help with deadline awareness and planning.

Email Reminder System

Configure customizable automated email reminders sent to task owners.

Reminders sent based on user-defined timing (e.g., days before task deadline).

Utilize asynchronous scheduling and scalable email delivery methods.

Project Environment Management

Use the astral-sh/uv package to initialize, alreay created the project by UV init ProjectPlanner and now we are in the folder project, package, and manage Python project environments.

Accept folder path inputs to initialize and launch project environments via uv, automating environment setup and dependency management.

Technology Stack

Backend: Python with FastAPI for RESTful API, user authentication (OAuth2/JWT), data modeling (Pydantic/SQLAlchemy), email integration (SMTP or third-party service like SendGrid) and background tasks.

Frontend: React with the latest Material UI (MUI v5 or newer) for an accessible, responsive, and modern UX, including login interfaces, dashboards, charts, and sharing dialogs.

Visualizations using Python libraries like Plotly or Matplotlib for Gantt and calendar charts, exposed via API or rendered client-side as appropriate.

Customization & Extensibility

Flexible metadata fields for projects, tasks, and subtasks configurable by users.

Robust, modular design to support future enhancements, such as notifications, advanced reporting, integration with calendar apps, or mobile-friendly interfaces.

Terminal & Automation Support

Provide generated Python and shell commands for terminal usage, letting users automate project creation, environment initialization, and server launching powered by uv.
